title: Mildred and Red as a formative influence
summary: Sauter says their devotion to music before commerce shaped his values.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Let's talk about her and Red a little more. What kind of relationship did you have with her?
Oh, wonderful. They were like big brother and big sister or mother or father; however you want to look at it. What an environment for a young person to be exposed to, because--
You were only about twenty four, twenty five years old.

No, I was younger than that, I was only about twenty when I first went. Everywhere else had been commercialism, and here was always--the first thing was concern for the music. It was always that way and no where else did I encounter that and I always look back and I think that is one of the reasons why I have
not been commercially successful. I'm frightened of boredom, I don't ever want to become bored with what I'm doing, and so far, I've been lucky, I haven't.

I think it comes from them, the same attitude stays with me and a thing like that has to be implanted when you're young or it won't work. I don't know if it's part of personality or the result of having someone to show you something that you know is the ultimate truth. If you find it early on-- I suppose you can discover it later--but it gets involved with a set of values.

I think it's very important; it's given me a love for music that I never lost, and I don't want to lose it. I can go just so far, I can always give; I can bend, I'm forced to bend if I want to make a living, we all have to do that, but I don't want to lose that and I don't think anyone can get it away from me anymore. I know they've tried very hard. I've been caspigated endlessly
for having that attitude. There is such a huge respect for cynicism in the commercial world, and I'm accused of being cynical. I don't get that at all.
In any case, you were in the right place at the right time.
